title: Oyo Aggyibwamu Okugezesebwa kw'Amazzi
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo by’ebyawandiikibwa eby’edda, waliwo ekifaananyi ekisikiriza ng’emboozi ye tetandikira na kyamagero kya katemba oba okubikkulirwa okuwuuma, wabula n’okugezesa okukkiriza okwangu naye nga kwa maanyi. Eggwanga lyayimirira ku nkulungo, nga linoonya obulagirizi obw’obwakatonda obw’obukulembeze. Ekyagenda mu maaso kyali kigezo kya magezi nnyo ne kiraga abakkiriza abatuufu mu bo. Osobola okusumulula ekyama kino okuva mu bubonero obulekeddwa emabega?
clues: Nnava mu lunyiriri abantu lwe baali beegomba, era Allah yannonda olw’ekigendererwa ekitukuvu kye bataasobola kutegeera.
Omubiri gwange gwali gutambuza akabonero ak’enjawulo abalala ke baali tebalina, ekyandeetera okuyimirira nga wa njawulo mu bantu bange.
Omugga bwe gwalangirirwa ng’ekigezo, abasinga ne badda emabega — naye ne nnyigiriza mu maaso, nga nvugibwa okukkiriza okutakyuka mu kisuubizo kya Allah.
Nnalagirwa obutanywa ku mazzi agaagaaniddwa, naye ate akatonnyeze kamu kaasimattuka emimwa gyange —ekibi ekyanyigiriza omutima gwange emirembe gyonna.
Allah yansalirawo okusisinkana omusumba omuto olunaku lumu yandifuuse legendary olw’okutta omulabe ow’amaanyi.
Amagye bwe gaakubagana, saagwa ku mukono gw’omulabe, wabula n’ekiragiro kya Katonda ng’ekibonerezo olw’obujeemu kwange ku mugga.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
